name: 86 Chaos 16.0.33 Free AI Capability Layer
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.33 Free AI Capability Layer
notes: Adds a protected free/public-data AI capability layer for 86Voice without changing the app shell, Firebase credentials, rules, or data structures.
Extends 86Voice with local operational readiness, labor, maintenance, weather-impact, and food-data lookup actions while preserving existing command grammar.
releaseNotes: 86Voice can now answer higher-level readiness, labor-risk, and maintenance-risk questions from currently loaded real app data.
Weather-impact checks use a protected public-data service when restaurant latitude/longitude already exists in app data.
Food-data lookups use public Open Food Facts data for allergen/nutrition hints and clearly require verification before guest-facing use.
A local AI capability registry documents free/browser/public-data options for voice, semantic search, OCR gateway, and public-data checks.
Visual design, Firebase credentials/config/rules/indexes, real screens, routes, and existing workflows are unchanged.
